::: {.why}
Everything a hiring process needs from you, assembled and rehearsed, and the test is the academia question rather than the document.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Have a CV, three write-ups, a firm list with reasons, sent outreach and a rehearsed presentation, all in one place.
- Answer the leaving-academia question in three sentences a researcher would find convincing.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>50 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Finish reports/milestone-11-dossier.md: the CV, the three two-page write-ups, the problem log with what you have solved and what you are still slow on, the recorded five-minute presentation, and the firm list with the outreach actually sent and its dates.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [20 min]{.task-min} Do the honest section: the problem log with your remaining weak categories named, and the timed mixed-set score trend from eleven sittings. A dossier that claims no weaknesses is one an interviewer discounts entirely.
:::
:::

## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Timed mixed set, twelfth sitting: five problems in fifteen minutes. Score, plot all twelve, and compare against the target you set on day 330.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Full mock round, second attempt: fifteen minutes, mixed, cold. Compare against day 350 and note whether the transitions have improved.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> The academia question, fourth and final rehearsed attempt, recorded. Play days 287, 308, 329 and today in sequence and keep whichever is best rather than the most recent.
:::
:::

## The running strategy

::: {.project}
Milestone 11 assembles the year's work into the form a hiring process consumes: three two-page write-ups drawn from the milestones, a CV that describes the genetics work in the language of the job, and a firm list with outreach already sent.
:::
